title: PLAID targets mid-January 2027 to resume KARTE after breach; data of ended-contract companies also affected
summary: PLAID suspended all KARTE services after unauthorized access on November 13. Its November 20 release says a vulnerability was exploited and 79,249 account emails and 45,816 contact records of its own were taken. Some customer data was also affected, by category: 570, 487, up to 409 and 754 companies. The set includes companies whose contracts had ended. PLAID targets a phased resumption in mid-January 2027, which it says may change.
plain: PLAID says its customer-data service KARTE should return in phases around mid-January 2027, and that data of companies that had ended their contracts was also hit.
exec: KARTE stays suspended until a target of mid-January 2027; data of former customers is also affected.
action: KARTE customers, including former ones, should wait for PLAID's contact: it says it will hand detailed data to affected companies sequentially from November 24.
